title: Waveform animation doesn't animate continuously
description:
## Problem
The WaveformMiniView animation appears random/inconsistent instead of smoothly animating.

## Root Cause
In `WaveformMiniView.swift`, the `startAnimating()` function sets random heights once, then relies on `.repeatForever()` to animate. However, this only repeats the transition to those values - it doesn't continuously generate new random values.

## Fix Applied
Replaced the one-shot animation with a Timer that continuously updates bar heights every 0.15 seconds, creating smooth continuous animation.

## Files Changed
- `Briefeed/Core/Utilities/Components/WaveformMiniView.swift`
